characters.name: Battle Beast
characters.description: A humanoid lion man named Thokk. He is constantly on the hunt for bigger and more powerful prey. Ax-Crazy: He wields a literal battle axe and ismurderouslyinsane. It says something when Thragg of all people thinks you're this, the paragon of Viltrumite ideals of combat and purity.Somewhat downplayed, though, by the fact that he still looks for a valuable reason to initiate a fight rather than simply attack of his own volition. He also seems to have standard: when he found out that the heroes that attacked Machine-Head weren't as strong as promised he chose to leave, but when going against a dictator he moves to kill regardless of how trivial the fight will be for him. Somewhat downplayed, though, by the fact that he still looks for a valuable reason to initiate a fight rather than simply attack of his own volition. He also seems to have standard: when he found out that the heroes that attacked Machine-Head weren't as strong as promised he chose to leave, but when going against a dictator he moves to kill regardless of how trivial the fight will be for him. A Beast in Name and Nature: Goes by the moniker Battle Beast, is a shamelessBlood Knightand has the appearance of a white, lion-like creature. For good measure, while technically on the side of the heroes, Thokk is only working with them to satisfy his own bloodlust. Being Evil Sucks: His curse causes him to be full of an unquenchable fury. By his own admission, he has to constantly fight the urge to attempt killing everyone he can lay eyes upon at every waking moment, hoping that death will free him from this burden.

characters.name: Thresha
characters.description: Action Girl: A fierce warrior and one of the few beings in the universe who can make Battle Beast bleed. All Amazons Want Hercules: She falls for Battle Beast after he kills her planet's tyrannical leader andafter he dies ends up with Space Racer whom she admires for his combat skills and ability to adapt quickly. Babies Ever After: Implied.In the epilogue we see an alien that's heavily implied to be her and Space Racer's child. Birds of a Feather: Downplayed. Just like her boyfriend, Thresha enjoys fighting and bloodshed, though unlike him she isn't eager to die in battle. I Want My Beloved to Be Happy: Subverted. She knows Thokk's greatest desire is to be felled in battle by aWorthy Opponent, but despite thisshe sets the Rognarr on Thragg before the fight even starts because she can't bear to watch him die.

characters.name: Space Racer
characters.description: An alien vigilante defeated and trapped by Omni-Man years ago. Rode around on a space motorcycle. The Ageless: Perhaps a result of his gun'sHealing Factor, but he doesn't seem to age at all. One hundred years after Nolan sealed him away, he still looks exactly the same.Even in the epilogue, which takes place decades in the future, he hasn't changed at all. Apologetic Attacker: He apologizes to Thresha for knocking her out when her anguish overThragg killing her lover Battle Beastmakes her lose it and compromise their escape. Babies Ever After:In the epilogue we get a brief glimpse of what is implied to be his and Thresha's daughter. Crippling Overspecialization: Unsurprisingly, he's very reliant on his gun to be an effective fighter. When Nolan and Allen encounter him again, they're able to restrain pretty easily after dodging his initial shot and he has to call on his motorcycle to get free from them.

characters.name: Universa
characters.description: A warrior woman from a dying planet seeking a renewable energy source, nuclear in this case. Expy: Of Queen Maxima (from Superman's rogue gallery). Glass Cannon: With her staff, she can cause some trouble with her super strength and energy bolts. Without her staff, she goes down easily. Green-Skinned Space Babe: An attractive humanoid alien queen, with the only thing that makes her look alien being her light green skin-tone. Jerkass: She doesn't care that siphoning energy from a nuclear power plant will cause mass destruction and is willing to kill and maim to get what she wants.

characters.name: The Rognarr
characters.description: Savage alien beasts from an unnamed planet and one of the few species capable of killing even the strongest Viltrumites. The Dreaded: Even Thragg is afraid of them, and rightfully so as they could have killed him if not for Battle Beast. The Viltrumite Empire at their peak weren't able to capture a single one and instead opted to freeze their entire planet by blocking out their sun. Heavyworlder: They evolved so they can withstand their planet's heavy gravity, which is dense enough to slow down even the speedy Viltrumites to being just as fast as normal humans. This gave them levels of strength and resilience rarely seen in any other species. Inconsistent Spelling: Their name shifts between Rognarr, Ragnarr, Ragnar, and Rognar from issue to issue.

characters.name: Reboot? Aliens
characters.description: Ambiguous Situation: The story acknowledges that Mark has no reason to take the aliens at their word. What if they were actually evil, and trying to undo some event that would affect their future? And even if they were telling the truth, they gained absolutely nothing by punishing him by sending him five years into the future instead of his proper time. However, there's never anything conclusive mentioned about them, leaving their actual motivations a mystery. Giant Space Flea from Nowhere: While not an enemy, they do appear out of nowhere to give Mark a chance to go back in time and redo his life over. Good Is Not Nice: They wanted Mark to sacrifice everything, including his daughter Terra, toSet Right What Once Went Wrong. When Mark, against their expectations, rejected their offer and wanted to return, the aliens were so outraged that they sent him five years into the future, leaving him unable to be with Eve and Terra during her early childhood. Jerkass Has a Point: Them sending Mark back five yearsafterhis disappearance was cruel, no argument there. Still, they have a point when they tell him he's being extremely selfish by choosing the life of his daughter over the billions he could save by changing the timeline for the better. Seeing as he doesn't even bother trying to defend himself when they lay into him, Mark seems to agree. The Needs of the Many: They try to convince Mark to stay in the new timeline, telling him that by changing the past, he'll save countless lives. They hoped that Mark would be selfless enough to agree with them, accept it and move on. They didn't count in the fact that he'd be unable to bear that his life was even worse than in the old timeline and that Terra wouldn't exist in it as Atom Eve never broke up with Rex.

characters.name: Salaka
characters.description: A deposed Fantanian prince that Thokk helps return to power. An Arm and a Leg: He's reduced to a torso, an arm and a head when Battle Beast first encounters him. Dirty Coward: He was one of these when Fantania was first conquered, but his shame at this may have allowed him to overcome this. Only time will tell. Good Thing You Can Heal: His access to a supernatural phenomenon called Royal Energy allowed him to survive for several hundred years in the belly of the Colossus.

characters.name: Telia
characters.description: Allen's girlfriend of unspecified humanoid alien species and sister of Atom Eve's ex-boyfriend, Kubian. Bizarre Alien Reproduction: See underExotic Equipmentbelow. Child Hater: Seems to be a trait of her entire species, as she explicitly mentions that her people "have no patience for children" and supported her brother Kubian's intent to have little Terra sent off elsewhere so he and Atom Eve can live together. Exotic Equipment: Whenever she is intimate with Allen she wraps tentacles that sprout from her back around his crotch area, which seems to provide her with sexual pleasure. Green-Skinned Space Babe: She's a fairly attractive looking humanoid alien with blue skin.

characters.name: Kubian
characters.description: Telia's brother, with whom Atom Eve had a brief relationship when Mark went missing for five years. Child Hater: Much like his sister (and seemingly the entire species as a whole), he hates children and sought to have Terra sent elsewhere so he can live with Atom Eve. Jerkass: Is shown to be incredibly unpleasant and smug, having enough audacity to claim to Eve in front of Mark (who just recently returned from his five-year absence) how he was a much better partner for her than Mark himself. Eve promptly decks him across the jaw for it. While Mark was gone, Kubian also made Eve choose between Terra and himself, which resulted in them breaking up. Although it's shown that he also understands Eve being upset with him and doesn't hold a grudge against her for punching him. Tentacle Hair: Much like his sister.
